newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egupt's Mubarak sees Arafat, EU envoy on Mideast.
newsitem.headline: Egupt's Mubarak sees Arafat, EU envoy on Mideast.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak had separate talks on the Middle East peace process on Wednesday with Palestinian President Yasser Arafat and European Union special envoy Miguel Angel Moratinos.
Arafat arrived in Cairo on Wednesday morning on his way back from the Organisation of African Unity summit in Harare.
Moratinos flew in on Tuesday evening from Israel, where he had talks with Foreign Minister David Levy.

Mubarak has been mediating between Israel and the Palestinians in an attempt to revive the peace talks which collapsed when Israel started building a new Jewish settlement in disputed East Jerusalem in March.
His senior political adviser, Osama el-Baz, has left for the United States, where he will have talks with unidentified U.S. officials, Egyptian government newspapers said on Wednesday.
Baz, who has visited Israel several times in the last few weeks, will brief the U.S. officials on his talks with Israeli and Palestinian leaders, they added.
Arafat and Moratinos did not speak to reporters after their meetings with Mubarak.
Moratinos will have more talks with Egyptian Foreign Minister Amr Moussa later on Wednesday, an official said.
